key_decisions: Mapped project phase, academic metadata, title review callouts, and action-needed styling to shared Badge variants and semantic tokens.

Kept the card route callback and focus/hover route prefetch; exposed keyboard Enter/Space activation with a visible focus ring and kept the CTA as a non-interactive Button-styled child to avoid nested controls.
Normalized repeated Team prefixes on presenter labels without changing the stored team name.
lessons_learned: Synthetic project card fixtures should use the shared project and title status constants so visual review exercises the same badges as persisted values.
The local Playwright package can run the required visual matrix using the installed Chrome executable and narrowly approved loopback access; no browser installation or live data mutation is needed.
